goldens.name: mempalace-roadmap
goldens.known_failure: 2026-08-02, note re-measured 2026-08-09: NOT an index defect and NOT a splinter-wing issue (wing metadata is already bare 'mempalace'; the wing_ in the ID is historical). Measured 2026-08-08 on the 174k-row corpus (memaudit agents 03+07): exact-cosine rank 91 unfiltered (the old '306th of 158k' note was pre-rewrite and stale), 22 with sessions excluded, 12 with sessions+cc excluded; HNSW returns it at 88 vs exact 91, so the index is exonerated. The binding constraint is the embedder: re-embedded with nomic-v1.5 the same drawer ranks 7 on the same data. wing=mempalace gives rank 3. Fix paths: embedder upgrade (lane spike), sessions curation, or add a wing filter to this case. Full measurement: .reports/mempalace-audit/ + drawer_mempalace_follow-ups_1529d3d1a36c5efb68d2bcf1.
